svg.text: What the filter has to do, and what an 85 actually does
transmission needed to flatten this lamp, normalised at 625 nm
580 — the Bayer hole, not the lamp
The 85 is the right shape and slightly too gentle in the green. It cannot follow the 580 nm spike, which is why the
realised gain is ×1.4–1.6 rather than the ×2.1 a perfectly matched filter would give.
⚠ The dashed curve is an APPROXIMATE published shape. Measure the real one: one reference capture with the filter,
divided by one without, IS its transmission on this rig's own wavelength axis.
